entities.summary: Bozhidar Lukarski is a Bulgarian politician and lawyer. He was the leader of Union of Democratic Forces from 2013 to 2018. From November 7, 2014 to January 27, 2017 he was the Minister of Economy in the Second Borisov Cabinet.
